description: This file defines a Orleans grain class named 'StreamingHistoryGrain' that implements streaming subscription management and observer interface to handle stream data of type int.

classes.name: StreamingHistoryGrain
classes.description: A Orleans grain that manages stream subscriptions, receives streamed integer data, and provides access to received items.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain as a consumer to a specified stream with optional filter data.

methods.name: GetReceivedItems
methods.description: Returns the list of received stream items.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Unsubscribes the grain from all active stream subscriptions.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream data by adding it to the received items list.
